stories.headline: Goldman Sachs limits access to Anthropic Claude Code and GitHub AI tools for engineers only
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs has removed AI coding assistants from traders and bankers, allowing only its engineering staff to use Anthropic's Claude Code and Microsoft's GitHub tools. The bank said the change follows a review of productivity and risk concerns.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows major financial firms tightening AI tool usage due to governance and risk considerations.

stories.headline: OpenAI secures $11 billion in new funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation
stories.summary: OpenAI announced a fresh financing round of $11 billion, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion after participation from SoftBank and MGX. The total funding could rise to $20 billion as additional commitments are finalized.
stories.whyItMatters: The capital influx underscores continued investor confidence in OpenAI’s growth and AI market leadership.
